regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and introductory/current-method prose
regions.finding: Current aqueous CuX2-mediated cyclization conditions and the distinction between current work and cited prior halolactonization methods were inspected; cited background was not converted into current experiments.

regions.region: page 1 lower-left Scheme 1 and adjacent resolution prose
regions.finding: Two successive current-paper stages: resolution/recrystallization to salt (+)-2a, then dilute-H2SO4 release of S-(+)-1a.

regions.region: page 1 upper-right Scheme 2 and adjacent prose
regions.finding: Two separate salt cyclizations, CuBr2 to S-(+)-3a and CuCl2 to S-(+)-3b, with distinct yields and ee values.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Scheme 3 and comparison prose
regions.finding: Two free-acid comparison cyclizations. The Scheme 3 arrow prints CuBr2 while the chlorinated outcome is supported by prose stating analogous use of CuCl2; the discrepancy is retained.
Prose reports both alpha-methylbenzylamine resolutions and four salt cyclizations; graphical confirmation appears on page 2 and is linked rather than duplicated.

unresolved: The main article supplies no complete experimental procedure, scales, concentrations, workups, purification details, or isolated masses.
The Scheme 2 CuCl2 reaction time is not explicitly stated.
The Scheme 3 arrow/reagent presentation for the chlorinated product is internally ambiguous.
No supplied SI is associated; missing details were not inferred.

regions.region: page 2 top Table 1, including reaction header, six rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: Six distinct substrate-scope experiments were transcribed row by row with R-group labels, salt rotations, CuX2 identity, reaction time, yield, ee, and applicable footnotes.
Two salt-resolution arrows and four separate CuBr2/CuCl2 cyclizations were identified; each condition/outcome pair is an independent record.

regions.region: page 2 notes and references, especially notes 9-10
regions.finding: HPLC ee method and X-ray assignment context were linked to matching records; bibliography and crystallographic-data citation were not fabricated into reactions.

unresolved: Table 1 and Scheme 4 omit reaction scales, workups, purifications, isolated masses, and yield bases.
Structures are represented by drawings and R-group labels; all SMILES remain null and unverified.
The article cites crystallographic data online, but no experimental SI file is supplied or explicitly associated in this pilot.
